decision_basis: Guide requirements and engineering runtime/numerical pilot; pilot task outcomes do not modify the paper grid or cohort counts

paper_config.numerical_scope: Native mean/log-normalizer flags bound series truncation in exact arithmetic, excluding rounding. The real N3 fallback compares two quadrature resolutions at tolerance1e-7, not a rigorous error enclosure. Tail/CDF and second-moment checks are separate.
paper_config.precision: Primary256 independent test episodes; calibration128 independent episodes with exact binomial intervals. Reporting times and queries are averaged within episodes. All precision flags are retained.
paper_config.variance_convention: sigma2 is per-real-coordinate variance, or proper-complex covariance; complex real/imaginary noise components have variance sigma2/2.
paper_config.causal_rule: One singleton correction; completed nonoverlapping past blocks; transported preceding prior fixed during EM; fitted variances used only for future corrections; streaming state is never replaced or augmented by fitted block posterior.
paper_config.timing_scope: Elapsed component clocks are execution metadata. Comparative warmed serial cadence timing is a separate root-owned stage.
paper_config.causal_warm_start: One current-parameter warm start per completed block; if signal variance is zero, also use a declared positive interior fallback. Multiple-start stationary reference experiments are retained separately.
paper_config.validation_scoring_scope: Policy validation uses independent observed held-out disturbance power or noisy held-out KKT response MSE. Hidden subspaces, normals and true covariance losses never select settings. Optional predictive density reports are not computed during task-policy selection.
paper_config.primary_beam_generator_seeds: SeedSequence([validation_seed or test_seed + seed_offset, 32, episode, 31]); same draws across interventions

estimate_scope: Rough execution budget from pilot checkpoint spans. Primary test grows from 3 to256 episodes per condition, validation from3 to64, calibration from6 to160 total per regime; paper complex posterior draws rise1024 to4096. Includes margin for concentration-dependent integration, serialization and competing jobs. This is not a latency benchmark.
precision_scope: N32 mean/log-normalizer and task study; posterior tails/calibration limited toN3. All unresolved flags are retained. Independent pointwise episode intervals, not simultaneous coverage guarantees.
source_freeze: Producer hashes are pinned in both canonical pilot manifests; all12 causal/physics/observed-CV regressions passed. Root general validation and explicit paper GO are still required.
